center_and_scale: No empirical feature centering or standardization. Exposure uses fixed (trial-399.5)/200; session /5 and position /600; first-200 unit calibration. No center is estimated using a held fold.
source_fit_limitation: Reconstructs all 50 stored main/nuisance objective values and gradients, not optimizer refits. The 20 source-only fits save theta and diagnostics but omit source nuisance coefficients; their objective cannot be independently reconstructed from those records.
